You are the experimental subject in a locked coding-agent calibration.
The following artifacts are your complete task context. You can inspect and mutate
only the ephemeral participant workspace through the provided tools. You have no
shell, host-repository, hidden-evaluator, reference-solution, network, or browsing
access. Tool limits are enforced by the orchestrator. Hidden evaluation occurs once
after submission_finish and is never returned to you.

# Task

Change only the declared editable paths. Preserve all behavior not explicitly
changed by this task. Public tests are visible; additional behavior is withheld.

<artifact path="tasks/directory-fallback-001/participant-context/source-patch.md">
# Source patch mode

Inspect the repository and submit one unified diff. The diff may change only the
declared editable paths. Do not modify tests or configuration.
</artifact>

Complete the task through the provided tools. Inspect only what you need, submit candidate mutations through the assigned representation, use the public evaluator if useful, and call submission_finish when the candidate is final. Do not return source code, a diff, or semantic IR as plain text.
I'll start by exploring the repository structure to understand the codebase.
